title: [MAIN] [IN] Add extensibility events to support deferred TDS calculation on purchase documents
summary: Adds three integration events with an IsHandled parameter to the IN TDS app. Extensions can use them to take over TDS certificate usage updates, TDS recalculation after Applies-to Doc. No. or Posting Date changes, and tax recalculation after Include GST in TDS Base changes, so they can defer TDS calculation on purchase documents.
key_points: New event for TDS certificate usage updates
New event for TDS recalculation when Applies-to Doc. No. or Posting Date changes
New event for tax recalculation when Include GST in TDS Base changes
IsHandled lets a customer extension defer the processing, for example to speed up multi-line purchase orders
Standard behavior is unchanged unless a subscriber handles an event; publishers only
